title: Cobblemon Sanctuary of Yveltal
description: Prepare to meet the powerful god of death Yveltal in the world of Cobblemon
body:
Cobblemon datapacks and mods completely overlook **_~~Yveltal~~_**, a great Pokémon with a beautiful design.

This datapack only adds a structure that can be found in the Nether and Dark Woods, where, by spending some buff, you can have a chance to battle and capture it.

Este mod necesita de Cobblemon 1.7 para funcionar y es compatible con Cobbleverse
